reddit.title: Improved Music Transitions in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music transitions in Provincia! No more hard cuts between day, night, title, and combat beds. Our new long equal-power self-crossfade hides the AI join, creating a smoother experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Provincia: Enhanced Audio Experience
steam.body: We're excited to announce an update to the audio system in Provincia! The transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds are now smoother than ever, thanks to our new equal-power self-crossfade feature. This improvement eliminates the previous hard cuts and enhances your immersion in the game. Learn more about this update and other features here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
